serviceName: Envío de emails desde tu dominio
description: Authenticates the email Miniemail sends from the creator's own domain through Amazon SES (eu-west-1): three Easy DKIM CNAMEs, a custom MAIL FROM subdomain (MX for bounces plus SPF merged with SPFM) and an optional monitoring-only DMARC record that Miniemail only requests (groupId=dmarc) after checking that the domain has no DMARC record. Apply on the sending domain: domain=<zone>, host=<subdomain> when the creator sends from a subdomain. No root SPF and no root MX are touched. CNAMEs must be DNS only (not proxied).
variableDescription: %dkim1%, %dkim2%, %dkim3%: the three Amazon SES Easy DKIM tokens of the sending identity (32 lowercase letters or digits each). Set by Miniemail, never by the user.
